newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenbao '96 net profit hits 43 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Shenbao '96 net profit hits 43 mln yuan.

text.p: Shenzhen Shenbao Industrial Co Ltd recorded net profits of 42.96 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Tuesday.
Earnings per share were 0.31 yuan in 1996 while turnover reached 112.83 million yuan, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.

The company posted net profits of 3.62 million yuan under Chinese accounting standards in 1995, according to the firm's annual report. The 1995 annual report did not give a net profit figure calculated using international standards.
The firm has proposed a one-for-10 bonus issue based on 1996 profits and another one-for-10 bonus issue based on capital surplus, the exchange said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, it said.
